info.name: ClinicalSummaryVoice
info.description:
One speaker dictates a clinical summary. POST the WAV; the response summary is one paragraph ending with Assessment and Plan.

Default audio: samples/chest_pain_summary.wav
Start the service with python main.py at http://localhost:8039.

request.description: Checks that the service is up and OpenAI is configured.
Multipart file upload. Returns summary and transcript.

response.name: Example 200

request.description: Full example. audio_base64 is the complete chest_pain_summary.wav recording, not a variable. The saved example shows the summary paragraph the service should return.
